meta.title: Experiences Store · Destination Paradise
meta.description: Choose Zanzibar experiences, dates and times. Book selected excursions instantly with a combined 20% deposit; pay the remaining 80% on each experience day.

pickups.safari-blue: Hotel pickup from south-coast and Stone Town areas, 07:15–07:45.
pickups.spice-tour: Hotel pickup from Stone Town and west-coast areas, 30 minutes before start.
pickups.stone-town: Meet at the Old Fort forecourt, or request pickup from a Stone Town hotel.

northern-safari.title: Northern Tanzania Safari
northern-safari.alt: Zebra herd on a safari track
northern-safari.blurb: A mainland safari across the Serengeti and Ngorongoro with wildlife drives, lodge nights, and light-aircraft transfers.

custom-journey.title: Custom Zanzibar Journey
custom-journey.alt: Aerial view of boats on turquoise water
custom-journey.blurb: Tell us how you want your days to feel and we will shape one private itinerary around dhows, spice gardens, beaches, and Stone Town.

hero.title: Find your experiences
hero.lead: Choose your island days and combine your experiences in one trip. Pay one 20% deposit, then the remaining 80% on the day of each experience.

list.title: Curated experiences
list.lead: Choose your dates, guests and pickup, add one or more experiences to Your trip, and pay a single 20% deposit at checkout.
list.empty: No experiences match your search yet — try a different word.

section.title: Choose your departure
section.lead: Pick a date, time and guests, and add experiences to one trip. Pay a combined 20% deposit at checkout, with the remaining 80% due on each experience day.
section.point_cart: Combine several experiences in one order
section.point_codes: A separate booking code for every trip
section.pickup_select_hint: Select your pickup area and accommodation below so we can confirm transport and the price.

panel.pick_date_hint: Select a date above to see available departures.
panel.not_charged: You won't be charged yet — review everything at checkout.
panel.small_car_hint: Online prices for up to 6 guests in one car; 7 or more guests need a quote.
panel.currency_estimate: Local-currency estimates. Your checkout quote is shown in USD.
panel.quote_large_group: Online booking supports up to 6 guests. For 7 or more guests, use Book Now for a separate enquiry.
panel.quote_other_area: This pickup area needs a separate enquiry through Book Now. Choose a listed area to book online.
panel.loading_prices: Checking the approved group and pickup prices…
panel.pricing_failed: We could not check the online price. You can save this trip and check prices again at checkout.
panel.quote_unpriced: An online price is currently unavailable for this selection. You can save this trip and check prices again at checkout.
panel.quote_no_payment: No online payment is taken when you request a quote.
panel.cart_full: Your trip already has 20 experiences. Edit or remove one in Your trip before adding another.
panel.reused_details: Pickup details are filled from your trip. You can change them for this experience.

cart.title: Your trip
cart.note: Add one or more experiences, then pay one combined 20% deposit. Each trip keeps its own date, time and guests.
cart.request_note: We confirm availability and price for your requested experiences first. After approval, pay one combined 20% deposit; the remaining 80% is due on each experience day.
cart.online_only: Enquiry-only trips cannot be paid in the Store. Keep online departures here and use Book Now for a separate enquiry.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.sub_one: One order, {{count}} experience · Destination Paradise is your single host.
checkout.sub_few: One order, {{count}} experiences · Destination Paradise is your single host.
checkout.sub_many: One order, {{count}} experiences · Destination Paradise is your single host.
checkout.sub_other: One order, {{count}} experiences · Destination Paradise is your single host.
checkout.payment_note: You'll pay through a secure Pesapal form on our website. Card and mobile-money details go directly to Pesapal; your bank may open a separate verification step.
checkout.recheck_note: Availability is re-checked before you pay.
checkout.terms_ack: By continuing you accept our <booking>Booking Policy</booking> and <terms>Terms of Service</terms>, including the cancellation charges that apply to your dates.
checkout.conflict: Some departures are no longer available. Please adjust the highlighted trips.
checkout.failed: We couldn't continue to payment. Please try again in a moment.
checkout.payment_unavailable: Online payment is temporarily unavailable. Your trips remain saved. Please try again or contact our team.
checkout.usd_note: Your trip and deposit are quoted in USD; other website currencies are estimates. Your payment provider may show a converted currency. Review its final amount and currency before paying.
checkout.privacy_notice: We use your contact and trip details to arrange your booking and payment. Read our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

errors.name_required: Please add the lead guest's name.
errors.email_invalid: That email address doesn't look right.

checkout.request_sub: No payment now — we confirm availability first, then you approve one final price.
checkout.request_note: We check every requested experience with our local partners and email you a confirmed plan with the final price, usually within 24 hours. Your places are held and paid only after you approve it.
checkout.request_footnote: Nothing is charged or held when you send a request.
checkout.request_pricing_hint: Requested experiences are priced in your confirmation email.
checkout.payment_note_preview: This preview simulates the 20% deposit — no payment is taken and no card or mobile-money details are entered. The remaining 80% is due on the day of your trip.
checkout.price_changed: The payment amount changed. Review the updated total and deposit before continuing.
checkout.quote_failed: We couldn't check the current price. Please try again before paying.
checkout.pickup_review: Choose a pickup area and accommodation for each trip, then review its price.
checkout.quote_required: An online price is unavailable for the highlighted selection. Review its group and pickup details. Payment remains unavailable until its price is confirmed.
checkout.online_only: Store checkout is for online departures. Remove enquiry-only trips from this cart and use Book Now for a separate request.
checkout.separate_enquiry: Open a separate enquiry in Book Now

confirm.processing_text: We're confirming order <ref>{{reference}}</ref> with our payment partner. This usually takes a few seconds — this page updates by itself.
confirm.problem_text: Order <ref>{{reference}}</ref> wasn't charged, or the payment needs a manual check. If money left your account we'll resolve it by email — otherwise you can simply try again.
confirm.title: Your next trip to Paradise
confirm.lead: Order <ref>{{reference}}</ref> is confirmed. A confirmation is on its way to your email — each experience has its own booking code below.
confirm.missing_text: This confirmation link has expired in this browser. Your email confirmation has all the details.
confirm.request_lead: Request <ref>{{reference}}</ref> is with our team. We're checking availability with our local partners and will email your confirmed plan and final price, usually within 24 hours.
confirm.request_footnote: Nothing is charged or held yet. You can close this page — everything continues by email.
confirm.quote_lead: Everything in request <ref>{{reference}}</ref> is confirmed by our partners. Review the plan and accept to hold your places and continue to payment.
confirm.accept_note: Accepting re-checks availability and holds your places. Then pay one combined 20% deposit; the remaining 80% is due on each experience day.
confirm.accept_note_full: Accepting re-checks availability and holds every place in your trip; payment follows as one combined amount.
confirm.accept_conflict: One of the departures just sold out. Our team has been notified and will email you an alternative.
confirm.accepted_payment_pending: Your places are held! Online payment opens shortly — we will email you the payment link.
confirm.deposit_lead: Order <ref>{{reference}}</ref> is confirmed and your 20% deposit has been received. Your confirmation email includes each booking code and the remaining balance.
confirm.balance_note: The remaining 80% is due on the day of your trip, before the experience begins.
confirm.refresh_failed_text: Your saved confirmation may have changed. Try again to check the current booking and payment status, or use the link in your confirmation email.
confirm.continue_pending: If you haven't finished payment, continue to secure checkout. We update your confirmation after the payment is verified.

payment.title: Pay securely here
payment.lead: Complete payment for order <ref>{{reference}}</ref> below. We confirm your booking after verifying the payment with Pesapal.
payment.description: Choose your payment method in the Pesapal form below. Card and mobile-money details go directly to Pesapal. Scroll inside the form to see any remaining fields.
payment.terms_hint: Review and accept Pesapal's terms in its form when you're ready to pay.
payment.ready: After paying, check your order status below.
payment.pending: Payment has not been confirmed yet. If you have already paid, wait a moment and check again.
payment.reload_hint: Reloading may clear details you've entered in the form.
payment.external_hint: If the form doesn't display, you can continue on Pesapal's secure page:
payment.unavailable: We couldn't open the secure payment form. Please check your order again or contact our team.

request_panel.lead: Tell us your preferred dates — we confirm availability and the final price by email, usually within 24 hours. Nothing is charged or held yet.
request_panel.foot: Joins your trip as a request — you'll approve the final price before any payment.

request_section.title: Tell us your dates
request_section.lead: This experience is arranged with our local partners, so we confirm availability before anything is booked or paid.
request_section.point_no_charge: No charge and no holds until you approve
request_section.point_confirm: We confirm dates and the final price within about 24 hours
request_section.point_one_payment: After availability is confirmed, pay a combined 20% deposit and 80% on each experience day
request_section.pickup_fallback: Pickup details are confirmed together with your dates.

pickup.title: Where are you staying?
pickup.hint: Choose your pickup area and enter your hotel or accommodation. Pickup supplements are charged once per car.
pickup.required_hint: Enter both your pickup area and accommodation to continue.
